name: App Tilt Hero
description: A product hero whose markup-drawn mail app window starts tilted back 22° and flattens as you scroll, while a soft spotlight behind it brightens.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono line above the headline, after a small accent dot.

props.name: muted
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 45% white.

props.name: primary
props.description: White pill with a download glyph.

props.name: account
props.description: Signed-in user shown in the title bar.

props.name: folders
props.description: Sidebar folders; the first is selected and its count heads the list.

props.name: threads
props.type: { from; initials; subject; preview; time; unread?; drafted? }[]
props.description: Rows in the list; drafted rows get a gold Draft chip.

props.name: message
props.type: { subject; from; fromEmail; to; time; body: string[]; draft: string[] }
props.description: The open thread and the reply Tern drafted for it.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Starting tilt in degrees; flattens to 0 as the window scrolls into place.
